from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier


def fit_predict(train_csv: str, test_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[float]:
    train = pd.read_csv(train_csv)
    
    # Handle missing values - empty strings become NaN
    train = train.replace('', pd.NA)
    
    y = train.pop("y").astype(int)
    
    test = pd.DataFrame(test_rows)
    test = test.reindex(columns=train.columns, fill_value=pd.NA)
    
    for name in train.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(train[name]):
            test[name] = pd.to_numeric(test[name], errors='coerce')
        else:
            all_cat = pd.concat([train[name], test[name]], ignore_index=True)
            categories = pd.Categorical(all_cat).categories
            train[name] = pd.Categorical(train[name], categories=categories)
            test[name] = pd.Categorical(test[name], categories=categories)
    
    model = LGBMClassifier(random_state=20261114, n_jobs=1, verbosity=-1)
    model.fit(train, y)
    return model.predict_proba(test)[:, 1].tolist()",
  "notes": "Implemented LightGBM with default parameters. Empty strings converted to pd.NA which LightGBM handles natively as missing values. Numeric coercion with errors='coerce' ensures invalid entries become NaN. Categorical alignment between train/test preserves encoding consistency."
}
